reason: I already take my own magnesium and reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. Two capsules every day is also more than I want to deal with, even if the sachets are handy when I travel.
objection: I already have a brand I reorder, and I would be paying more per day to swap for something I have never tried.
would_change_my_mind: A single capsule a day, or a price clearly below what I pay now for the same dose.
